description_en: Queries the details of an international flight order
description_zh: 查询国际机票订单详情
name: IFlightOrderDetailQuery

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access credential.

When calling this API over HTTP, this parameter is required and must be appended to the request URL. For how to obtain the credential, see Enterprise Access Credential (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).

When appending the parameter, use the format crop_token=value
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。

通过 HTTP 方式调用本接口时，需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。

在拼接时，推荐使用 crop_token=value
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token
